correctness.rationale: Exact pairwise Euclidean distances yield precisely four thresholds; an explicit row/column nerve gives the first wedge; a contractible-lower-fiber poset map identifies the intermediate complex equivariantly with Hom(K2,Kn), with an explicit l1 sphere homeomorphism; the antipodal pairs form a cross-polytope join at the penultimate scale. Group traces follow from oriented nerve chains and exterior-power determinants; distinct homology degrees give exact integral barcodes. Standalone code independently checks finite face counts, prime-field ranks and all 240 symmetries for n=5; infinite claims are derived symbolically.

value.rationale: A natural all-rank Euclidean root family gets a complete integral homotopy and persistence classification, including a transition from O(n^2) circles to spheres in dimensions n-2 and binomial(n,2)-1. The full S_n x C2 homology character refines ordinary Betti numbers, and the poset fiber equivalence exposes a meaningful link between metric geometry and graph homomorphism complexes. The result is not an arbitrary finite slice or routine table recomputation.
